flags.why: This is a disparaging label for a person, as illustrated in this [discussion of its use](https://www.nongnghiephaingoai.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Cuon4_BietRoiKhoLam_By_TranVanGiang.pdf), so the learner needs a derogatory warning.
The example explains the word's meaning instead of using it to refer to a rose.
flags.fix: Nàng cài một đóa mai khôi lên tóc. = She tucked a rose into her hair.

flags.why: The example defines the animal instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Chúng tôi nhìn thấy một con manh giông trong hang. = We saw an olm in the cave.

flags.why: The example gives an anatomical definition instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Bác sĩ phát hiện một khối u ở manh tràng. = The doctor found a tumour in the caecum.
